title: Sticker – CLOUD ISLAND VAPOUR
description:
CLOUD ISLAND VAPOUR Stickers are made of thick, high-quality waterproof vinyl material and are precisely die-cut to shape, giving them a premium look and feel. They are a perfect way to add some personality to anything that looks bare. Moreover, these vinyl stickers can be easily removed without leaving any tearing or residue behind, in case you change your mind.

*1 Free sticker or magnet per order.

Specifications:

- Size: 3″ x 2.55″

- Material: Vinyl

- Indoor / Outdoor

- Waterproof

- UV Resistant

Includes:

1 X CLOUD ISLAND VAPOUR Sticker
